{"metadata":{"description":"Multi-agent team collaboration for DeepSeek Harness, with independent models, skills, MCP tools, contexts, and a shared workspace.","id":"gh:1336524975","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"agent-team","slug":"limuyang2/agent-team","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Multi-agent team collaboration for DeepSeek Harness, with independent models, skills, MCP tools, con"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"texts, and a shared workspace."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Agent Team for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Current release: `0.1.4`"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Build teams of independent AI agents inside DeepSeek Harness. Mix models and providers, assign one L"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"eader, and let every member work in its own conversation while sharing the same Workspace."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Agent Team does **not** turn members into subagents. Every member is an independent root agent with "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"its own model, session, context, permissions, reasoning mode, and tool activity. Team tasks, message"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"s, and the shared Workspace provide the collaboration layer."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why Independent Agents Instead of One Overloaded Agent?"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Agent Team is designed around a simple idea: **give specialized work to a specialized agent**."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"A common parent/subagent workflow reuses or inherits much of the parent runtime configuration. That "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"is convenient, but it can make every task carry the same expensive model, broad tool catalog, and gr"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"owing context. A small commit-message task, for example, may still run through the same high-capabil"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ity model used for architecture and implementation."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Agent Team lets every member have an explicit, focused configuration:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Concern | Common parent/subagent setup | Agent Team |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Model | Often reuses the parent model or one shared model policy | Choose a different provider and"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" model for every member |
| Skills and MCP | A broad catalog may be inherited or exposed everywhere "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"| Give each role only the Skills and MCP Servers it needs |
| Context | Planning, execution, tool ou"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"tput, and results accumulate together | Every member has an isolated Session and context window |
| "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"Cost | Simple work may still consume an expensive general model | Route routine work to smaller or s"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"pecialized models |
| Permissions | One broad permission policy can spread across the workflow | Set"},{"id":"p12s7","text":" least-privilege defaults and runtime permissions per member |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"This separation keeps the Leader focused on planning and verification, keeps specialists focused on "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"execution, reduces irrelevant tool choices, and prevents one agent's context from growing with every"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" detail produced by the whole team. Members send tasks, progress, and results explicitly instead of "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"sharing an ever-expanding conversation."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"> Subagent behavior varies by framework. The comparison above describes the common parent-inherited "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"pattern; Agent Team's advantage is that model, tools, permissions, and context isolation are explici"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"t product-level choices for every member."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Example: Use the Right Model for Each Job"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Consider a software development team with three specialized members:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Role | Model | Focused configuration |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Architecture Leader | GPT | Understand the requirement, design the solution, split work, coordinat"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"e members, and verify results |
| Coding Agent | GLM | Load coding Skills and development MCP tools,"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" modify the Workspace, and run tests |
| Commit Assistant | DeepSeek Flash | Read Git status and dif"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"fs, then generate a Conventional Commit message with read-only permission |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The GPT Leader spends its context on decisions and verification instead of every implementation deta"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"il. GLM receives the codebase context and tools required for execution. DeepSeek Flash handles the n"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"arrow commit task quickly without paying for the Leader's higher-capability model or loading the cod"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ing agent's large tool catalog."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The collaboration flow is explicit:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## What You Can Do"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- Create reusable assistants for planning, coding, testing, review, documentation, or any other role"},{"id":"p23s2","text":".
- Mix providers and models in one team—for example, a Codex Leader with GLM coding members.
- Crea"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"te assistants manually or describe a role to the built-in **Team Agent Assistant**.
- Add the same a"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ssistant more than once; every selection becomes an independent team member.
- Watch all members sid"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"e by side with streaming output, Markdown, Think blocks, and tool calls.
- Let the Leader create tas"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ks, assign members, track progress, and collect results.
- Send messages directly to the Leader or, "},{"id":"p23s7","text":"when enabled, to regular members.
- Change a member's permission preset and reasoning mode for the c"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"urrent session.
- Inspect loaded Skills, context usage, token statistics, and cache hit rate.
- Brow"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"se shared Workspace files and preview Git changes and diffs.
- Add or remove members, change the Lea"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"der, reset all contexts, or dissolve a team."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Create an Assistant by Conversation"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Describe the role you need.
